title: Naturally Tender Japanese Goat Onigiri
description: A fermented and tender Japanese dish featuring goat meat, double-rise-bread, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, formed into onigiri shapes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground goat meat, bread crumbs, Japanese rice vinegar, mirin, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Knead the mixture for about 10 minutes until it becomes sticky and cohesive.
Divide the mixture into 6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a triangle.
Place the shaped onigiri on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the onigiri in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the onigiri from the oven and let them cool to room temperature.
Serve the onigiri at room temperature, garnished with chopped scallions.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
